baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated q-d-y predicates at words 2 and 9 are split between affirmation with haqq and total negation with shay.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first predicate is a decisive, reality-matched judgment; the mirrored predicate is denied across the entire object domain. Invocation of an alternative therefore yields neither jurisdiction nor a binding result.

activation_trace.role: Decisive adjudication supplies the mirrored act that is affirmed for God and denied of the invoked figures.
Stable correspondence with reality qualifies the positive judgment and excludes arbitrary force.
A voiced call directed toward an addressee makes the rival relation a request for responsive authority.
Otherness marks the invoked figures as alternatives outside the sole source of judgment.
The maximally general knowable object gives the negative clause unrestricted scope.

changed_reading.before: God judges truthfully, whereas other gods judge nothing.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an asymmetrical tribunal: one authority issues binding decisions that match reality, while every invoked alternative has an empty adjudicative domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The q-d-y pair can denote completion and effective execution as well as courtroom judgment, while shay can denote an object of will.
baseline_models.mechanism: On this branch, qada is the carrying of an intended affair through to a finished, effective state. The rivals' inability is therefore practical and ontological, not merely an inability to pronounce a verdict.

activation_trace.role: Completion and exhaustion open a process reading in which an affair reaches its endpoint.
Precisely made and effective action shifts the contrast from verbal ruling toward enactment.
The relation between will and a thing makes the negated object a possible intended actuality.

changed_reading.after: God alone carries an affair through to completed actuality; the invoked alternatives cannot consummate even one intended thing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair al-sami and al-basir immediately follows the contrast in qada.
baseline_models.mechanism: Auditory reception, understanding, visual observation, and inward discernment form a two-channel warrant for judgment. The names explain why the positive qada is with truth rather than merely appending praise.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment is the operation for which the final perceptual pair supplies warrant.
Reception of voiced evidence supplies the auditory side of the adjudicative record.
Understanding and acceptance extend hearing from raw sound to grasped testimony.
Direct sight supplies observation of visible acts and conditions.
Inward discernment supplies knowledge that penetrates beyond visible appearance.

changed_reading.before: The hearing and seeing names are a general doxological close.
changed_reading.after: The names function as the evidentiary warrant of the verdict: every utterance is received and every visible or inward fact is discerned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early false disputation tries to make truth lose its footing; the exact later reprise of qada with haqq ends with the falsifiers losing. The focus judgment is thus a reversal operation that restores truth's standing and removes falsehood's.

activation_trace.role: Decisive adjudication is the central operation that reverses the contested relation.
Truth made manifest gives qada an active stabilizing role rather than a merely descriptive quality.
Twisted disputation supplies the adversarial pressure placed upon truth.
Loss of truth and stability characterizes the medium used by the disputants.
A foot slipping from its hold supplies the attempted displacement of truth.
The later exact adjudicative predicate makes the focus construction an event with a disclosed outcome.
Manifested truth marks what the later judgment establishes.
General loss supplies the reversed outcome now borne by the false side.
Those defined by instability and departure from truth become the losers rather than the dislodgers.

structural_cues: At 40:5 false disputation is explicitly directed at dislodging truth; at 40:78 the focus construction returns and falsifiers lose.
The two scenes reverse agent and patient: falsehood first acts upon truth, then truth-bearing judgment acts upon falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the attempted displacement and the later loss; I infer that the focus clause is the hinge reversing that direction. A live alternative is that the two episodes simply repeat condemnation without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: Judging with truth means issuing a correct verdict.
changed_reading.after: Judging with truth is the act that reverses falsehood's attempted displacement: it re-establishes truth and transfers loss to the falsifying claimants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places solitary invocation and partnership immediately before the declaration that judgment belongs to God, then makes failed leaders concede that God has already judged between the servants. Rival inability is therefore lack of delegated jurisdiction, not merely weak performance.

activation_trace.role: Decisive adjudication supplies the jurisdiction whose exclusive ownership is tested.
Calling identifies the attempted route to an alternative authority.
Otherness locates that attempted authority outside the rightful jurisdiction.
The call directed to God alone supplies the rejected exclusive relation.
Partnership supplies the attempted sharing of authority that the hearers accept.
Judgment between people is explicitly assigned to God after the invocation contrast.
The failed leaders' concession confirms that judgment between servants has already been exercised elsewhere.

structural_cues: At 40:12 the call-versus-partnership contrast resolves directly into exclusive divine judgment.
At 40:47-48 dependents appeal to their former leaders, but the leaders can only point to God's completed judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-located invocation, association, and exclusive judgment; I infer a jurisdictional boundary that no invoked partner can cross. The alternative is a simpler contrast of power or competence without legal delegation.

changed_reading.before: The rivals are too powerless to judge.
changed_reading.after: The rivals are categorically unauthorized co-adjudicators: invocation cannot delegate even the smallest part of God's jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, covert eye-action and concealed interiors are known; later the same hearing-seeing pair follows unsupported dispute and pride hidden in breasts. The closing names therefore describe an audit that joins public speech, visible conduct, and concealed motive before judgment.

activation_trace.role: Auditory reception brings every voiced plea and argument into the record.
Understanding turns heard speech into assessed testimony rather than undifferentiated sound.
Inward discernment lets the audit reach motive and meaning beyond appearance.
Disclosure to the knower supplies complete access to otherwise hidden evidence.
A covert breach of fidelity supplies an act designed to evade ordinary witnesses.
Concealment supplies the evidentiary boundary that divine perception crosses.
The inward source from which acts issue locates motive within the audit.
Twisted dispute supplies the audible public presentation being assessed.
A compelling warrant is explicitly absent, making source validation central.
Magnification within the chest supplies the concealed motive beneath the argument.
The repeated hearing title marks comprehension of the disputants' speech.
The repeated seeing title marks discernment of the pride hidden behind that speech.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding ayah moves from a covert eye-act to what breasts conceal.
At 40:56 unsupported disputation, inward pride, and the exact hearing-seeing pair occur in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden evidence, public argument, absent warrant, and concealed motive; I infer that the final names are the audit basis of qada. They could alternatively remain a general assurance of omniscience without a specifically forensic function.

changed_reading.before: God hears and sees everything in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: The judge receives every utterance, validates its warrant, observes conduct, and penetrates concealed motive; truth-bearing judgment follows a complete evidentiary audit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later call sequence distinguishes calls with no standing, calls that go missing, and a call answered by God. The focus can therefore contrast a complete response circuit with invocations that terminate without an effective answer or settled result.

activation_trace.role: A voiced call initiates the response circuit tested by the rest of the surah.
Hearing supplies reception at the divine end of a successful call.
Effective execution supplies the terminal act that converts reception into consequential response.
The paired call forms deny the rival destination any viable call in either temporal domain.
Repeated calling supplies an attempted appeal whose endpoint is explicitly ineffective.
A lost object supplies the image of a call that never reaches an efficacious destination.
The imperative to call supplies the valid opening of the divine response circuit.
Returned speech and answer supply the explicit successful endpoint absent from rival invocation.

structural_cues: The sequence 40:41-43 contrasts reciprocal calls toward rescue and fire, then denies the rival call standing.
The failed appeal of 40:49-50 is answered by the direct call-and-answer promise of 40:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, reception, failed arrival, and answer; I supply the arrow from divine hearing through qada to effective response. The live alternative is that qada remains purely judicial and the prayer sequence is only a thematic contrast.

changed_reading.before: People pray to rivals, but those rivals cannot judge.
changed_reading.after: Rival invocation is an open circuit: no received call becomes an effective settled outcome, while divine hearing proceeds to answer and consequential action.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 40:68 qada of an affair is ordered directly before speech and realized being. That sequence activates the effective-making branch of qada and makes the focus contrast include the ability to carry an affair from settled intent into actuality.

activation_trace.role: Effective, well-formed execution supplies the focus sense sharpened by the later command sequence.
A thing as the object of will supplies the possible actuality rivals cannot realize.
The same effective-making branch explicitly governs an affair in the later sequence.
An affair or state supplies the content settled by qada.
Articulated speech supplies the transition from settled affair toward realization.
Occurrence and temporal presence supply the realized endpoint of the sequence.

structural_cues: At 40:68 giving life and death is followed by qada of an affair, divine speech, and immediate being.
The sequence preserves ordered stages rather than using qada as an isolated legal term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four ordered elements: settled affair, utterance, occurrence, and presence; I supply the causal arrow from qada through speech to actuality. A live alternative is that qada only decides the affair and a distinct command performs it.

changed_reading.before: God issues the uniquely true ruling.
changed_reading.after: God's qada can be performative completion: an affair is settled, voiced, and made actual, whereas rivals cannot carry even one thing across that sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah individualizes recompense by acquisition, blocks an effective intercessor, and depicts dependents asking leaders to absorb an assigned share before those leaders invoke God's completed judgment. The debt-discharge branch of qada makes rival inability include failure to settle or transfer even a fragment of liability.

activation_trace.role: Payment and full discharge of a due right supply the liability-settlement sense under contextual activation.
The unrestricted object makes the denial reach even the smallest transferable item or share.
Action met by its counterpart supplies individualized recompense.
What a self acquires supplies the personal account to which recompense attaches.
An intercessor joining another's case supplies the blocked route for burden transfer.
A prevailing legal argument supplies the explicit dispute over responsibility in the fire.
Sufficiency supplies the requested ability of leaders to relieve their dependents.
An assigned elevated share supplies the portion the dependents ask the leaders to absorb.
Completed judgment between servants fixes the allocation the leaders cannot renegotiate.

structural_cues: At 40:17 each self receives the counterpart of what it acquired, with no injustice.
At 40:18 no obeyed intercessor is available; at 40:47-48 leaders cannot absorb even a share for their dependents because judgment is fixed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies individualized earning, blocked joinder, an attempted share transfer, and fixed judgment; I infer that qada's discharge sense connects adjudication to settlement of liability. The alternative is that qada denotes verdict only and the debt image should remain latent.

changed_reading.before: The invoked figures cannot issue decisions.
changed_reading.after: No invoked patron can discharge a caller's account, absorb an assigned share, or transfer even one item of liability after the truthful judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material branch of haqq pictures a fitting joint or receptacle, while contextual zulm pictures putting something outside its proper place and recompense is like-for-like. Qada with haqq can therefore be modeled as fitting each case into its proper legal and moral place.

activation_trace.role: A part fitting its joint or receptacle supplies the material image of exact placement.
Exact and effective construction supplies the act of placing a case into that fit.
Any knowable object becomes a possible item requiring correct placement.
Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the negated failure mode.
Equivalence supplies the matching relation between deed and consequence.
Restraint and corrective return supply the function that restores a disordered relation.

structural_cues: The no-injustice statement at 40:17 is immediately adjacent to the focus and defines the prohibited misplacement.
At 40:40 an evil act receives its like, giving the placement model a proportional matching rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material fit, contextual misplacement, and equivalence; I infer a justice-as-correct-placement mechanism. A live alternative is ordinary proportional fairness with no intended material image.

changed_reading.before: God judges according to abstract truth.
changed_reading.after: God fits every deed, claim, and consequence into its proper joint; the alternatives cannot correctly place or settle even one thing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah every thing is encompassed, nothing is hidden, kingship is singularly claimed, and every thing is created by God. The negated shay in the focus then describes an empty rival domain: no object remains outside divine knowledge, ownership, and making for another authority to adjudicate.

activation_trace.role: Otherness proposes a rival domain whose contents the context tests.
The unrestricted knowable object defines the candidate domain over which judgment could operate.
Adjudication supplies the authority whose object domain is partitioned.
Unopposed expansiveness supplies total encompassing scope.
Every knowable object fills that encompassing scope.
Concealment is denied any capacity to remove an object from divine access.
The unrestricted object again closes the possibility of a hidden remainder.
Sovereign rule supplies ownership of the whole exposed domain.
Origination supplies the deepest basis for authority over the domain.
Every knowable object is included in the created set, leaving no residual object for rivals.

structural_cues: The universal shay recurs with encompassing mercy and knowledge, non-concealment, and creation.
The kingship question at 40:16 is answered within the same universal-object frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total scope, non-concealment, sovereignty, and creation; I infer that these exhaust the possible object set and leave rival jurisdiction empty. The alternative is rhetorical universality without a formal domain contrast.

changed_reading.before: The rivals happen not to judge anything.
changed_reading.after: They have nothing available to judge: every possible object is already encompassed, exposed, owned, and created within divine jurisdiction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because call or worship remains the primary sense of d-a-w, but the focus inventory also supplies claiming a right or affiliation and the surah surrounds the focus with contested truth and absent warrant. Downstream prose should present it only as a forensic secondary echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins d-a-w, q-d-y, and haqq in one contrast, allowing invocation to echo the advancement of a claim before a judge.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation lets invocation also sound like putting forward a litigated authority.
A right owned by its claimant supplies the subject matter such a pleading would seek to vindicate.
Opposing parties each asserting truth supplies the contested forensic setting.
Decisive adjudication supplies the tribunal before which the claimed authority fails.
Twisted contest supplies the surrounding pattern of litigated assertions.
The absent compelling proof exposes the rival pleading as unauthorized.

changed_reading.before: Those people worship or call other beings.
changed_reading.after: They also put those beings forward as claimed authorities, but the pleading cannot establish a right or produce a decision about anything.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because min dunihi idiomatically marks alternatives besides God, yet its branch also means nearer than and short of a goal, while qada can mean completion and the Pharaoh scene dramatizes failed ascent through connections. Render it only as a secondary spatial pressure on the idiom, not as its sole lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Dun at word 7 can picture being below or short of the endpoint, while q-d-y at words 2 and 9 can picture reaching completion.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that falls short of the goal locates rival authorities below the terminal source.
Completion supplies the endpoint that lower intermediaries cannot reach.
Reaching a limit supplies Pharaoh's attempted movement toward the inaccessible endpoint.
A cord or connection supplies the imagined chain of intermediary access.
Ascending to overlook and uncover supplies the failed attempt to inspect the divine endpoint from below.

changed_reading.before: The phrase refers to beings other than God.
changed_reading.after: It also faintly pictures a chain of authorities that remains below and short of completion: no intermediary can carry an affair all the way to its terminal result.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The material image is surprising and branch-distant, but it remains anchored in the focus haqq inventory and is activated by the surah's contrast between making truth slip and an outcome that hits its target. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image of decisiveness, not a lexical paraphrase of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Haqq at word 3 includes a straight thrust that penetrates, while q-d-y includes effective execution.

activation_trace.role: A straight thrust that penetrates without veering supplies the verdict's material trajectory.
Effective execution turns the straight trajectory into a consequential act.
Slippage supplies the opposing attempt to make truth veer or lose purchase.
Aimed contact with a target supplies the contextual image of an announced consequence landing.

changed_reading.after: The verdict also carries a contained image of straight, non-glancing force: it reaches and penetrates the point that false disputation tried to make slip.

strongest_changes: The 40:5 to 40:78 arc turns qada with haqq into a reversal that restores truth's footing and makes falsifiers lose.
The ordered qada-speech-being sequence at 40:68 strongly activates performative completion alongside legal judgment.
The immediate hidden-evidence frame and the repeated hearing-seeing pair at 40:56 make the closing names an adjudicative audit.
The failed patronage scene activates qada as nontransferable liability and unsuccessful discharge, not only verdict.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did not collapse qada into one sense: adjudication, effective completion, discharge of liability, and correct placement remained coexisting readings, all constrained by the focus call-truth-hearing-seeing structure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 40:68 causally folds creation into qada or merely places decision before a distinct performative command.
Whether the claim sense of d-a-w and the below-the-goal sense of dun are intended secondary echoes or only licensed exploratory branches.
Whether the material fit and penetrating images of haqq should reach prose synthesis or remain trace-only diagnostics.
